# AGL#19 resource-list fixture (included by lib2_agl_19_commands_resource_list.txt): render method resource lists
# built by their own constructor 027D56E4 on placement storage (as RenderLayerPrefix::create 027C3280 builds each
# element of its resource array) and filled through addUnique 027D57B8 (RenderLayerPrefix::registerResourceMethod
# 027C23F8 passes each render-method token).
# Tokens: agl::render::RenderMethod objects, 0x30 bytes, whose constructor is inlined into every
# owner, so they are built here with exactly the constructor's values: Disposer words +0/+4/+8 = 0, class vtable
# 10169E3C at +0xC, SafeText name {shipped name, SafeText vtable} at +0x10/+0x14, mode +0x18 in {1, 2} (set before
# registration), sort key +0x1C in {0, 100} (0 from the constructor; 100 is LayerShadow's freeShadowTexture_ token,
# 02736618), delegate {10004ADC, owner, s16 0, s16 -1, 02033F58} at +0x20..+0x2F. Owners are distinct stable blocks.
# agl::detail::RootNode::sInstance (101F8C1C) is 0 as the world leaves it (no producer builds the debug root node; the
# name notification 02785CB4 returns at once), as in lib2_agl_16_views.
include shared/agl_world.txt
